title: 白宫经济顾问：4万岗位就够，加息理由不足？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We kick you off to the close today with Chris Falon. He's the White House's chair of the Council of Economic Advisors.
segments.zh: 今天我们请到克里斯·法伦来收盘。他是白宫经济顾问委员会主席。

segments.en: Chris, let's get right to it here. Pay me a picture of how you see the U.S. job market right now.
segments.zh: 克里斯，直接开始吧。说说你现在怎么看美国就业市场。

segments.en: The U.S. job market, we say, has to add 40,000 jobs a month to, we call it the break-even rate.
segments.zh: 美国就业市场，我们说每月必须新增4万个岗位，我们称之为盈亏平衡线。

segments.en: Because of essentially demographic changes, the baby boom is reaching, essentially retirement age, and also net immigration is down. So really the U.S. economy in order
segments.zh: 因为人口结构变化，婴儿潮一代基本到了退休年龄，净移民也在减少。所以美国经济要

segments.en: to keep the unemployment rate at about where it is needs to create 40,000 a month.
segments.zh: 把失业率维持在当前水平，每月就需要创造4万个岗位。

segments.en: As you said over the last three months, it's created 51,000 a month. In 2026, it's done about 65,000 a month. So the unemployment rate went officially from 4.1 to 4.2, but it really went from 4.14 and
segments.zh: 如你所说，过去三个月每月新增5.1万。2026年每月约6.5万。所以官方失业率从4.1%到4.2%，但实际是从4.14%

segments.en: changed to 4.17 and changed. It really didn't change at all. Well, I do have to add to you, though. I mean, even at 40,000, I mean, with an average, a three-month average of 51,000,
segments.zh: 变到4.17%，其实根本没变。不过我得补充，即使按4万算，三个月均值5.1万，

segments.en: we're only slightly above that. And it gets to this idea not so much as to whether the job market is weak. I don't think anyone could say that in any sort of honesty. But it does raise some
segments.zh: 也只是略高于这个水平。这就引出一个问题，不是就业市场是否疲软——我觉得没人能诚实地说它疲软。但它确实引发了一些

segments.en: questions about the durability, certainly heading into 2027, and whether there should maybe be policy changes to maybe make sure that we don't deteriorate any further. The best policy changes that one can
segments.zh: 关于持久性的疑问，尤其是进入2027年，以及是否该调整政策来确保不会进一步承压。最好的政策调整就是

segments.en: do are simply we have an investment boom going, keep the changes that are keeping that going,
segments.zh: 我们正处在**热潮中，保持那些推动热潮的变化，
